crossRefs.note: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their…
For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.
Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves…
while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen…
For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with…
But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

translations.web: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.
translations.bsb: Now those who say such things show that they are seeking a country of their own.
translations.kjv: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
translations.asv: For they that say such things make it manifest that they are seeking after a country of their own.
